description: Meet the trees and shrubs of sunny slopes and open woodlands.

plants.name: Ponderosa pine
plants.tip: Look for long needles bundled in groups of two or three. Mature bark forms broad orange-brown plates.
plants.prompt: Which feature points to ponderosa pine?

plants.name: Gambel oak
plants.tip: Its simple leaves have rounded lobes. It often forms thickets and produces acorns.
plants.prompt: Which feature supports identifying Gambel oak?

plants.name: Rocky Mountain juniper
plants.tip: Adult foliage has small scale-like leaves. The blue berry-like structures are fleshy cones.

description: Practice noticing shapes and adaptations in the desert.

plants.name: Saguaro
plants.tip: A tall columnar cactus with pleated green stems. Arms can develop with age; young plants may have none.
plants.prompt: Can a young saguaro lack arms?

plants.name: Blue palo verde
plants.tip: Blue-green bark helps this desert tree photosynthesize. Leaves are small and flowers are yellow.
plants.prompt: Which clue is especially useful for blue palo verde?

plants.name: Creosote bush
plants.tip: Look for small paired leaflets with a resinous coating and yellow flowers. Use several traits together.
options: Paired resinous leaflets and yellow flowers
